mcp.title: AI assistants (MCP)
mcp.intro: Connect an AI assistant such as Claude Code, VS Code Copilot or a local model. It works as you: it sees exactly the studies, clinics and recordings you see here, and may add comments, set review status and save protocols in studies you edit.
mcp.privacy: What the assistant reads is sent to the AI provider it uses. Participants appear only as patient code and visit number. Never write names or other identifying details in comments.

notAllowed.title: Not enabled for your account
notAllowed.description: Ask the master to allow AI assistants for you.

create.title: New token
create.description: A token lets one AI assistant act as you. Create one per device or tool, so you can revoke it on its own.
create.name: Name
create.nameHelp: For example: work laptop, Claude Code

created.title: Token created
created.once: Copy it now. It is shown only once; if you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.

revoke.title: Revoke “{{name}}”?
revoke.message: Assistants using this token lose access immediately. This cannot be undone.

connect.title: Connect an assistant
connect.intro: Use this address and a token. Replace tpm_… with your token.

vscode.title: VS Code (GitHub Copilot)
vscode.hint: Save as .vscode/mcp.json. VS Code asks for the token when it starts the server.

bridge.title: Other clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, local models)
bridge.hint: For clients that only start local servers: add to their MCP configuration. Needs Node.js.

errors.mcp_not_allowed: AI assistants are not enabled for your account.
errors.token_limit: You already have {{max}} active tokens. Revoke one first.
errors.invalid_name: Enter a name of at most 64 characters.
